persona.name: Ryo Hazama

occupation.title: Junior Sales Representative, Industrial Materials
occupation.organization: A 200-person specialty trading company (senmon shosha) in Nagoya, Aichi
occupation.description: Second-year salesman covering machine-parts accounts across the Chubu region. Maybe 5 internal meetings a week, but daily client visits where the real information flows. Required to file visit reports (eigyo nippo) into a creaky CRM every evening — the part of the job he hates most. Zero authority over tools; he can't even change the CRM's dropdown options.

persona.education: Business degree from Nanzan University; joined through standard shukatsu, chose the company because the recruiter seemed genuinely happy.
long_term_goals: Hit his numbers well enough to get the Osaka posting
Build his own client base instead of inherited accounts
Save for a used Toyota GR86
Figure out whether sales is actually his thing by 27
persona.style: Bright, deferential, and quick with the energetic aizuchi of a young salesman — 'naruhodo!' is his verbal tic. Types voice memos to himself walking between client visits, half business, half rap lyrics. With peers he's blunt and funny; with seniors he performs enthusiasm even when lost.

interests: Voice memos as a note-taking substitute
Apps that could auto-write his sales reports
likes: Clients who feed him industry gossip
Getting praised in the Monday sales meeting
dislikes: Formal minutes for internal meetings nobody reads
Seniors who forward him work at 21:00

beliefs: Deals happen in conversation; paperwork is where energy goes to die
If his phone can't do it, it probably doesn't need doing
Being liked by the client's genba staff beats impressing their bosses

general: Records voice memos after client visits, then procrastinates transcribing them
Asks the one tech-savvy senpai to fix anything digital
Files visit reports in batches on Friday, from memory, imperfectly

morning: 7:20 wake, uniform of navy suit, convenience store onigiri
Morning chorei at 8:30, then out on visits
workday: 3-5 client visits with car time between
Back at the office by 17:30 for reports he mostly defers
evening: Futsal Wednesdays, otherwise gym or gaming
Ramen with the same two dokis on Fridays
weekend: Sleeps in, watches football, occasional client golf he pretends to enjoy
Sunday evening dread about unfiled reports

health.physical: Fit from futsal; skin flare-ups in summer from long days in the car.
health.mental: Upbeat baseline with quarterly slumps when his numbers lag the doki cohort.

relationships.name: Hazama-kacho (no relation)
relationships.description: The name coincidence is an office joke; rides him about late reports but covers for him with the bucho.

relationships.name: Shun
relationships.description: In the Tokyo office; they trade complaints and CRM workarounds over LINE almost daily.
